name: suitecut
description: Build narrated videos directly from Playwright browser flows.
author: skyaara

scripts.test:browsers: pnpm build && SUITECUT_MANIFEST_PATH=.suitecut/browser-support.json playwright test examples/browser-support.spec.ts && node scripts/verify-browser-manifest.mjs .suitecut/browser-support.json
scripts.test:browser-flows: pnpm build && playwright test --project=chromium examples/browser-presentation.spec.ts examples/checkpoint.spec.ts examples/popup-tour.spec.ts
scripts.test:retry-parallel: node scripts/clean-retry-parallel-lib.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --outDir .suitecut/retry-parallel-lib && playwright test --config tests/retry-parallel/playwright.config.ts && node scripts/verify-retry-parallel.mjs .suitecut/retry-parallel.json
scripts.examples:playwright: pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types examples/playwright.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/playwright/checkpoints.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/playwright/popup-tour.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/playwright/custom-setup.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/playwright/product-tour.ts
scripts.demo:site: pnpm build && SUITECUT_SITE_RECORD=1 playwright test --config site/playwright.config.ts site-demo.spec.ts && node dist/cli.js render --manifest .suitecut/site-demo-run.json --output .suitecut/videos/suitecut-site-demo.mp4 --width 3840 --height 2160 --fps 60 && cp .suitecut/videos/suitecut-site-demo.mp4 site/public/demo/suitecut-field-manual.mp4 && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -ss 1 -i .suitecut/videos/suitecut-site-demo.mp4 -frames:v 1 site/public/demo/suitecut-field-manual-poster.png
scripts.demo:docs-features-4k: pnpm build && SUITECUT_SITE_PORT=4332 SUITECUT_SITE_RECORD=1 SUITECUT_SITE_MANIFEST_PATH=.suitecut/docs-features-4k.json playwright test --config site/playwright.config.ts docs-feature-tour.spec.ts && node dist/cli.js render --manifest .suitecut/docs-features-4k.json --output .suitecut/videos/docs-features-4k.mp4 --width 3840 --height 2160 --fps 60 --quality master
scripts.demo:zoom-motion-4k: pnpm build && SUITECUT_SITE_PORT=4333 SUITECUT_SITE_RECORD=1 SUITECUT_SITE_4K=1 SUITECUT_SITE_MANIFEST_PATH=.suitecut/zoom-motion-4k.json playwright test --config site/playwright.config.ts zoom-motion.spec.ts && node dist/cli.js render --manifest .suitecut/zoom-motion-4k.json --output .suitecut/videos/zoom-motion-4k.mp4 --width 3840 --height 2160 --fps 60 --quality high
scripts.check: pnpm site:sync && pnpm build && pnpm audio-plugins:check && pnpm test:audio-plugin:built && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test -- --run
scripts.audio-plugins:build: pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-sherpa-core build && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-vits build && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-matcha build && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-kokoro-sherpa build && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-kitten build && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-zipvoice build && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-pocket build && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-supertonic build
scripts.audio-plugins:check: pnpm audio-plugins:build && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-sherpa-core check && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-vits check && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-matcha check && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-kokoro-sherpa check && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-kitten check && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-zipvoice check && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-pocket check && pnpm --filter @suitecut/audio-supertonic check
scripts.test:package: pnpm build && pnpm audio-plugins:build && pnpm test:package:built
scripts.test:platform: vitest run tests/atomic-file.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts tests/manifest.test.ts tests/process.test.ts tests/report-redaction.test.ts tests/timeline.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm check && pnpm site:check && pnpm site:build && pnpm test:package:built
